items.note: もらいます (moraimasu, receive) in its て-form plus もいいですか — the same permission pattern as すわってもいいですか and (しゃしんを)とってもいいですか in this lesson, here asking to receive something.

items.english: On, in (particle marking where something is put, written or parked)
items.note: Marks the place or thing an action leaves its result on: ここに なまえを かきます (koko ni namae o kakimasu, write your name here), いすに すわります (isu ni suwarimasu, sit on a chair). The verbs this chapter names with it are かきます, すわります, おきます and とめます. Lesson 12's に is different: it marks where something simply is, with あります or います.
